text:
pat.sales: Quick thread - EvergreenHealth procurement wants a compact "assurance snapshot" to close the PO. They listed: SOC 2 summary (not full report), ISO certificate excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation letter, a redacted staging network sketch, and a short BYOK/KMS separation note. They also asked whether Dedicated + BYOK changes the quote and whether SLAs change. Need a one-paragraph reply + ETA.
anika.security: We can produce a 1-page SOC2 summary (control coverage), the ISO cert excerpt, and our standard one-page pen-test attestation signed by the Security Lead. We explicitly do not release full penetration reports or raw logs. For BYOK/KMS note we'll provide a short diagram + bullet points about key separation and HSM usage. ETA: 48-72 hours for sanitization + legal sign-off on the attestation.
tom.ops: If they want to run an external scanner against our staging we can provision ephemeral creds + a presigned upload path. Host-level or on-prem scans require a scoped SOW and network review. Presigned naming conv: `evergreen_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`, TTL 7d. Also note: enabling BYOK with Dedicated requires additional smoke tests and key handshake work (~2-3 business days).
harper.eng: I'll prepare a redacted network sketch and a 1-page KMS separation note pulled from our ops playbook. Will strip internal CIDRs/hostnames. ETA ~48h.
pat.sales: Pricing + SLA text I can send to procurement? They want to know delta and whether SLA is different on Dedicated + BYOK.
revops-bot: Preliminary guidance: Dedicated capacity is a committed SKU (monthly/annual). BYOK/customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise tier (platform fee) + a one-time integration charge. Typical uplift depends on committed level; ballpark say ~15-25% uplift on hosted list for Dedicated commitment, plus integration. Final numbers from RevOps after deal details.
anika.security: SLA note: our stated latency/availability SLAs for Dedicated customers are the same contractual targets, but BYOK integrations add a short onboarding window where performance is validated; we don't change core SLA but any SLO exceptions during onboarding are handled per the SOW.
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.docx available: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.docx (uploader: legal-bot). Legal approval required on final attestation text (typical 3-7 business days if redlines).
tom.ops: I'll create the presigned bucket when Harper gives the artifact and post masked upload creds here.
harper.eng: Starting redaction now; will push to presigned path when ready (ETA 48h).
pat.sales: Draft paragraph for procurement: "We can provide a compact assurance snapshot (1-page SOC2 summary, ISO certificate excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, redacted staging network sketch, and a BYOK/KMS separation note) within ~3 business days. Pen-test attestation requires legal sign-off and may take up to 7 business days. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS (BYOK) is treated as an Enterprise add-on: it requires a Dedicated commitment and usually a one-time integration/SOW charge; RevOps will confirm exact pricing. SLA targets remain the same for Dedicated, but BYOK onboarding includes a short validation period. If you require scanning access, we can provide ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload link (7-day TTL); host-level scans or raw report access require a formal SOW and legal NDA"
anika.security: LGTM. Add: "We will not provide full penetration reports; we can provide remediation attestations if needed"
pat.sales: Sending to procurement now and marking pricing as provisional. Will escalate if they push for full reports.
revops-bot: Noted - RevOps will prepare a provisional quote when ARTIFACT_ID/commitment level is provided.
pat.sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:
